prediction.controls: per (reader, pair) as 0020: float16 floor, identity and scrambled on the agentic text itself; no far control (no far_pair): a reader whose scrambled misses 0.1 is UNEVALUABLE and its rung UNREAD. The scrambled control takes the next row's prefix (wrap 49 -> 0), so under the suite-blocked rows it pairs within suite everywhere but rows 24 (-> 25) and 49 (-> 0): the weaker form, stated in 0030
descriptive_not_sealed: the per-lag ratio agentic / corpus and agentic / on-path against seed 1 and seed 2 (seed 2 corpus at lag 32: 4.629e-06; seed 2 rollout at lag 32: 9.322e-02)
the two suites read separately over their twenty-five rows each (coding rows 0-24, workflow 25-49): per-suite medians are reported, not sealed
the per-window join with linear-ceiling's mapper reading of the same fifty windows (its entry 0064): median mean-KL per window and lag beside the per-sequence R2 drop at k = 1; a figure, no verdict
the scrambled medians per reader against 0018's 0.552-0.552 on corpus and 0029's 0.114-0.124 on rollout
the six re-derived distance.json values against 0018's rel_delta_all (expected identical: same weights)
prediction.halting: a floor over 1e-4 halts the reader run (0014); the distance refusal above (a code addition); the step-0 and step-g weights restored from the private Hub backup must hash to the manifest the backup carries
prediction.kind: statistic (B) on the own run (0017, seed 1) read on a fourth text, `agentic`: the 50 MLPerf Agentic Inference windows linear-ceiling's cell reads under the mapper (one bridge; the same token ids row for row), every row held out; the clauses place the reading against seed 1's own readings on corpus / on-path (0018) and rollout (0018), which this seal carries

distance_must_equal.statement: the six new rung labels' results/distance/rungs/<label>/distance.json, re-derived on the sitting machine from the same step-0 / step-g weights, must carry rel_delta_all equal to 0018's for the same step within 1e-9 relative; summarize_reader.assert_distance_pins refuses the summary otherwise (a rung with no distance file has no position and refuses too: the provenance fallback does not exist for the own run's checkpoints)

i_backbone_quadratic.fit: least squares of log median (B1) on log rel_delta_all, per text
i_backbone_quadratic.statement: clause (iv): least squares of log median (B1) on log rel_delta_all over the six rungs, slope in [1.5, 2.5] on the agentic text (seed 1 read 2.26 on corpus and 2.19 on on-path, 0018)

i_heldout_holds_at_every_lag.statement: clause (ii) of the entry, the sealed direction (read by the summarizer as i-holds): median (B1) on `agentic` <= 0.001 (HOLDS_B) at every lag rung, every rung above 2x its reader's floor

iii_lands_with.statement: clause (iii): at every lag the agentic median is closer, in log10, to seed 1's corpus median than to seed 1's rollout median at the same lag, by at least 1.0 decade; read by the summarizer as `lands`, which also names the side each lag lands with

iv_controls_as_0020.statement: clause (i) of the entry (read by the summarizer as iv): every (reader, pair) unit passes its controls under 0014's limits (float16 floor <= 1e-4, identity <= 1e-5, scrambled >= 0.1) on the agentic text; no unit UNEVALUABLE

prediction.statistic: per rung and text, median over held-out sequences of the mean per-token KL(pi_fresh || pi_stale) over the continuation (B1), nats/token; x = whole-vector relative L2 weight distance of the reader (step g) to the writer (step 0), tools/weight_distance.py

tokens.rule: linear-ceiling ledger entry 0016 section 4 (first window per trajectory, equal stratification, rows written suite by suite), restated in tools/agentic_tokens.py; at the same seed the same rows as linear-ceiling's file
